description: This plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four network components: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 50. The "attn_output" data is represented by a blue dashed line without markers; it begins near 0 at layer 0, remains relatively flat and low until layer 15, exhibits minor fluctuations such as reaching approximately 25 at layer 18 and 30 at layer 20, and concludes with a sharp increase to roughly 110 at layer 23. The "attn_residual" data is shown as an orange dotted line without markers; it starts near 0 at layer 0, rises steadily to approximately 25 at layer 10 and 100 at layer 18, reaches about 140 at layer 21, and ends with a sharp spike to approximately 260 at layer 23. The "ffn_output" data is depicted by a green dash-dot line without markers; it starts near 0 at layer 0, remains consistently low below 20 for most of the range, begins to rise to roughly 45 at layer 22, and spikes to approximately 160 at layer 23. Finally, the "ffn_residual" data is represented by a red solid line without markers; it begins near 0 at layer 0, increases steadily to about 25 at layer 10, 100 at layer 18, and 180 at layer 22, before ending with a steep spike to approximately 385 at layer 23.
